definitions.short: Shammua , the name of four Israelites
definitions.full: H8051. Shammua שַׁמּוּעַ proper name, masculine 1. son of David 2Sam 5:14 = 1Chr 14:4 Σαμμους [ε] , Σαμαα (= שִׁמְעָא 2 ). 2 Reubenite , Num 13:4 , Σαμουηλ , Σαλαμιηλ etc. 3 Levite , Neh 11:17 (= שְׁמַעְיָה 1Chr 9:16 ), Σαμουει , etc.; 12:18 (? same person), ᵐ5 L Σαμουε .

occurrences.englishText: These are the names of those who were born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
These are the names of the children whom he had in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,

and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, who was the chief to begin the thanksgiving in prayer, and Bakbukiah, the second among his brothers; and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.
of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;
